ptBR.note: Brazil often says ir para (vou para casa) and the gerund for what is happening now. The vou comer future is the same in both countries.

tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: O que é que vais jantar esta noite?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “O que é que vais fazer amanhã?”

B hears the question and builds the answer with ir + infinitive. Only ir changes (vou, vais, vai, vamos, vão); the second verb stays in the infinitive, with no a and no de in between: vou ligar. A tile like “não” goes before ir: Não vamos comprar. A tile in brackets like (eu) says who is speaking: it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
